name: bifrost
description: Open-source, high-performance AI gateway that works as your LLM gateway, MCP gateway and agent gateway. One OpenAI-compatible API for 10,000+ models, with failover, load balancing, semantic caching, virtual keys, budgets and MCP Code Mode. Works with any SDK or agent and adds under 200µs of overhead at 5k RPS.

analysis.summary_en: Bifrost is a high-performance AI gateway that unifies access to 23+ providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex, and more) through a single OpenAI-compatible API.
highlights: User Provisioning (OIDC) - OAuth 2.0 / OIDC login with background directory sync for teams, roles, and business units
Governance - Usage tracking, rate limiting, and fine-grained access control
Custom Plugins - Extensible middleware architecture for analytics, monitoring, and custom logic
Budget Management - Cost control and governance
